entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, about that flyer.[n]We're doing it at night, right?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm usually in Shibuya[n]at those hours.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Let me know when you're going to it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You better not leave me behind, OK?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll never forgive you if you do.
